trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy release in production was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions and verified the service is now healthy (error rate down from 18% to 0.2%).
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0; the on-call engineer has been paged.
